stemMd: Why compare sellers with similar recent sales?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To reduce pre-existing popularity differences when examining the effect of display position

options.label: C
options.textMd: To make the ranking entirely random forever

options.label: E
options.textMd: To guarantee identical products and customers

explanationMd: Matching on recent sales helps hold the ranking's underlying popularity measure more nearly constant. Varying position then gives a clearer test of visibility, though it does not guarantee perfect equivalence in all respects.

distractorRationale.c: The proposal is temporary and limited.
distractorRationale.e: Similar sales do not guarantee those identities.
distractorRationale.d: The design does not require failure.
distractorRationale.b: Later purchases are the outcome measured.
